source.name: Provo City GIS public parking facilities plus OpenStreetMap amenity=parking inside Provo city limits
source.note: Provo City GIS: public lots/garages only (city records edited 2018–2023); outlines simplified to about 10 m. OSM: amenity=parking in OSM relation 198903 (Provo), excluding BYU/MTC campus lots and explicitly restricted access. Hours, space counts and whether you may park are not verified by this app. On-street coverage is only OSM street_side/lane tags.
